title: Routed campus ticket: OSPF route not advertised
summary: Restore a missing remote route after proving the adjacency is Full.
brief: All router adjacencies are Full, but EDGE-A has no OSPF route to the SITE-B LAN. Verify the neighbor state first, then compare OSPF network participation and route tables. This model derives advertised prefixes and selected OSPF routes across Full adjacencies only; it does not model LSAs, metrics, DR/BDR, timers, authentication, or packet forwarding.
objectives: Advertise the SITE-B LAN in area 0
Verify EDGE-A selects the remote OSPF route
hints: A Full adjacency and missing route point to advertisement or selection, not Hello packets.
